long_description:
Purify your body, elevate your energy, and embody your mastery in this upcoming Reiki Master Certification Retreat November 9th-14th. 

This Reiki Master Retreat is designed for practitioners who feel called to go deeper into their own self healing, their embodiment, and spiritual leadership. 

In this retreat you will experience powerful healing modalities that support your nervous system and energetic purification such as unwinding in a watsu healing session in natural hot springs, purify your energy/body in a peaceful salt cave, and a few other experiences. Water softens what has been rigid in your energetic field while salt purifies what has been heavy. 

You will not only leave a certified Master/teacher but as well as more clearer, grounded, and more deeply connected than when you have arrived. 

For more information or to register and save your space for this healing experience call or text 2085301949. 

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Salt Lake City.
